name: Worktree Removal Evidence Guard
summary: Observe dirty Git state immediately before Claude Code removes an isolated worktree.
description: A deterministic fail-open WorktreeRemove observer that runs a bounded read-only Git status and reports only the number of changed entries, never paths or content.
refuses: It does not create, retain, delete, clean, commit, stash, or modify a worktree.
It does not claim to prevent removal because WorktreeRemove has no decision control.
It does not print changed paths, diff content, branch names, or repository remotes.
It does not follow a symbolic-link worktree path or run project-provided commands.

entrypoints.purpose: Count dirty worktree entries before removal without exposing file paths or changing repository state.
